evidence.detail: HOURLY = True — classifier still runs only as an hourly batch job, not at deck-add time
add_deck() does not call archetype_classifier at all; no per-deck classification at submission time
run() loads ALL unclassified decks (up to 100), computes cross-deck similarity, then makes LLM API calls — not designed for single-deck invocation

triage.notes: The classifier has been upgraded to use Claude LLM (anthropic_api_key) since the issue was filed. Per-deck classification at add_deck time requires restructuring run() to accept a single deck_id, making the similarity and metadata loads per-deck-efficient, and running asynchronously to avoid blocking user responses — more than an easy-fix.
